data_point: Recently launched paid pricing, a new revenue line or subscription billing
run_when: An older snapshot of the pricing page or a launch post is available.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company recently launched paid pricing, a new revenue line or subscription billing.
prompt.definition: Recent means within about six months.
yes_when: An older snapshot had no pricing and the current site does
A recent post announces paid plans or a new product line
no_when: Pricing has been the same for a long time
watch_out_for: A price change is not a launch
where_to_look: Old snapshots of the pricing page

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
